scope: This continuation only; previous counts remain historical
count_definition: Producer-scoped logical operation groups, not system-call counts or host-wide instrumentation. Nine post-boot infrastructure groups: create volume/seed, resize disk, create VM, configure VM, boot VM, power off, disconnect NIC, eject seed media, remove seed DVD device. Evidence/read-only queries/tool downloads/image retention are separate administrative artifact actions.
external_restart: One later boot observed and attributed to authorized user-controlled restart; agent restart count zero; no claim about all host-wide intervening reboots
test_exception: Authorized generic fixture tests may create synthetic IDs and simulated capabilities. They are not real SRC-001 IDs, host attestation, provider calls, native workers, replay, F-03 repair, or independent acceptance.
